# A book whose top-level Assets and Equity accounts are held in HKD, beside a
# top-level Investments account holding NASDAQ:AMZN shares.
#
# Only top-level accounts held in a currency decide the book's currency; an
# account holding shares is held in no currency (Q-042). So this book is kept
# in HKD.
#
# What this fixture produces: Assets and Equity in HKD, and Investments in
# NASDAQ:AMZN.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_the_currency_a_book_is_kept_in.py.
2026-01-01 commodity HKD
	mnemonic: "HKD"
	fullname: "Hong Kong Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity AMZN
	mnemonic: "AMZN"
	fullname: "Amazon.com Inc"
	namespace: "NASDAQ"
	fraction: 10000
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Investments
	type: "Stock"
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
